name: create-invoice
description: Creates a draft Stripe invoice for a customer with line items (invoice items), and optionally sends it, which finalizes it and emails it to the customer. The customer id comes from stripe__find-customer or stripe__create-customer; a price id comes from stripe__list-products, or an item gives its own amount, currency and description.

customer.description: Stripe customer ID from stripe__find-customer or stripe__create-customer.

items.description: Line items. Each item must provide either price (and optional quantity), or amount, currency, and description (and optional quantity).

amount.description: Unit amount in the currency's smallest unit.

daysUntilDue.description: Days the customer has to pay once the invoice is sent. Defaults to 30.

send.description: Whether to finalize the invoice and email it to the customer now. Defaults to false, which leaves a draft.
